info.name: Matcha 6.1 - Complete API Verification
info.description: Complete Matcha REST verification collection. Import the matching local environment, run Login, resolve the target username, then exercise protected domains. Browser-only Socket.IO, WebRTC audio, cookie-policy, OAuth, and UI scenarios are documented in MANUAL_AND_POSTMAN_TESTING.md.
